card.title: HENDERSON FIELD
card.text: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.

Text.SourceString: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.
Text.LocalizedString: Henderson Field is the air base the US is constructing on Guadalcanal.

value.value: The enemy has holed up in hard to reach hillside forts. We must figure out how to best dislodge them from their position.

SourceString.value: The enemy has holed up in hard to reach hillside forts. We must figure out how to best dislodge them from their position.

value.value: Your men have fought valiantly. The island is almost ours.

SourceString.value: Your men have fought valiantly. The island is almost ours.

value.value: We have finally cleared the foothills of enemy units and are now ready to tackle the forts themselves.

SourceString.value: We have finally cleared the foothills of enemy units and are now ready to tackle the forts themselves.

value.value: We are one hill closer to conquering Mount Austen. Keep up the good work!
